trades.thesis: TEVA fell 8.7% (closed at the low, 1.4x volume) after the R&D head/CMO resigned one week after its first R&D Day, plus a settlement in the generics price-fixing case. The company says strategy and expectations are unchanged, 9 buy ratings with a median PT of 50, and the stock has round-tripped the entire R&D Day rally (39 to 44.5 and back to 38.5). A single executive exit with no change to guidance or pipeline looks over-discounted and should partly retrace.
